fullPassage: When you purchase an item, you are paying not just for the item, but the costs to get that item to you. Let's say you visit a farm and buy a tomato. It might cost the farmer very little to grow a tomato, so the farmer might be able to sell you a tomato for much less than it would cost in the supermarket and still make a nice profit. When you buy that tomato at a supermarket, however, there are a number of costs that result in you paying much more than you would pay the farmer.
